title: feat(objectql)!: a tool holds one name per package (bare-name one holder, after the AI family)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9T7XkgYLhpd9ZEZyjhEBoYV)_

Fixes #31414

`tool` joins the bare-name one-holder list after the AI family of #30803 (PR #31375), by the maintainer's acceptance of a separate card for it. Claim 6725057016 (`domain:server#1`, card-thread session_01ADHkmS1DVx9CH1xvXikQBW).

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — measured on head `30b6c84f` and, for base `69244406`, by the ablation that puts base's list back: the engine's package door (`SchemaRegistry.installPackage`) and item seam (`SchemaRegistry.registerItem`) refuse, after the cold boot, a package registration they accepted on base: one whose tool bears a name another installed package holds (base list: `install-local` answers `200` and the tool is shadowed; head: `422 PLUGIN_REGISTER_FAILED`). Nothing is widened.
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` does not teach that two packages may share a tool name (grep: zero hits), and the naming rule itself is phase 2's (#30805); the prescription ships in the refusal and warning text and in ADR-0048's dated note P1.10.

⚠️ **Tier H**: this diff touches `docs/adr/0048-cross-package-metadata-collision.md` (a new dated note, P1.10, under the 2026-11-06 addendum, and `tool` named in the header's Addenda entry, §3.4's 2026-11-06 note, P1.5 and P1.9; ⛔ not the Status line, which draft PR #31586 edits). The seat routes the approver.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`tool` 加入"一个名字只认一个包"的列表(排在 agent、skill 之后)。冷启动结束后，第二个包再声明同名 tool,安装门和注册口都拒绝，返回 422 `NAMESPACE_CONFLICT`,点出两个持有包和改名建议；已经同名的部署照常启动、只告警一次。
- 为什么改：tool 的所有读者都只按裸名找它：`/meta/tool/NAME` 返回先注册包的那个；skill 的 `tools` 列表只能写裸名；MCP 服务器一个名字只能注册一个 tool;tool 调用协议里没有包。所以两个同名 tool 必然有一个被静默遮蔽。
- 风险与回滚：只收窄接受集，不改已存数据；示例应用和平台包都没声明 tool,现有部署不会启动失败(冷启动只告警)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/bare-name-one-holder.ts`(列表末尾加 `tool` 及其理由短句)、ADR-0048 P1.10、`registry-bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/registry-bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.test.ts` —— 预期 38 passed。
- 需要你做的：ADR 改动是 Tier H,需要审批人批准后由席位落地。

## What changes

- **`packages/objectql/src/bare-name-one-holder.ts`** — `tool` joins `BARE_NAME_ONE_HOLDER_TYPES` last, after the AI family (`BARE_NAME_REGISTRY_TYPES` stays derived): its collection key (`tools`), consumer clause ("a skill's `tools` and an MCP client name a tool") and noun, empty built-in and overridable-baseline sets. Module doc: the measurement.
- **`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`**, **`packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts`** — comments name `tool` among the covered types; no code change. Both doors and the cold-boot seal are generic over the list.
- **`packages/objectql/src/registry-bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.test.ts`** — `tool` runs through the AI family's matrix (it is the shared harness for these types). Forced edits, named: the whole-list cell now ends in `'tool'`; the `declaredBareNames` cell's "a tool declares nothing" now asserts tools declare (nested plugin included); the CONTROL "two packages' tools under one name both install after the seal" is replaced, since that is now the refused case, by CONTROLs for different tool names across packages, a tool versus another package's skill or agent under one name, and one package's skill and tool under one name.
- **`packages/qa/dogfood/test/bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.dogfood.test.ts`** — forced edits, named: the cold-boot cell asserted the warning never names the tool; it now asserts it does (with its rename) and that `/meta/tool/NAME` keeps serving `alpha`; the CONTROL `epsilon` installed the shared tool name and now declares a fresh one. New: `install-local` of `zeta` declaring the held tool name is `422 PLUGIN_REGISTER_FAILED`.
- **`docs/adr/0048-cross-package-metadata-collision.md`** (Tier H) — new dated note **P1.10 (2026-11-08)** under the 2026-11-06 addendum: the measurement (this repo's readers and the cloud reading), what is refused, the cold boot. `tool` is also named in the header's Addenda entry, §3.4's 2026-11-06 note (and dropped from its "keeps §3.4" list), P1.5 and P1.9's "Not in the list" (seat ruling B on the claim, restated 6726705019). The Status line is untouched.
- **`scripts/adr-anchors/packages__objectql__src__bare-name-one-holder.ts.json`** — the invariant names `tool` after the AI family.
- **`.changeset/31414-bare-name-tool.md`** — `@objectstack/objectql` `minor`, both declaration lines (the first restated `no (narrowing)` per the seat's ruling), BREAKING Why / Before / Now / The cold boot / Who moves / Unchanged, `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, measured producers.

## Why (measured)

Step 1 of the card, how a tool is resolved by name. No cloud read access in this container (attaching `objectstack-ai/cloud` was refused), so the cloud question went to `repo:cloud#3` on mailbox #31366 (seat's comment 6725074004), answered on the card (6725094995, read at cloud `ba6f0fa`). Both sides:

| Reader | Where | Package context |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `GET /meta/tool/NAME` | protocol by-name read | none: first-registered package's tool, silently, either order; a third package after the boot installs `200`, shadowed (PR #31375 table, re-pinned here by the dogfood file) |
| a skill's `tools` list | `packages/spec/src/ai/skill.zod.ts` `SkillSchema.tools` | none: the regex admits a bare snake_case name only; "bound by the cloud agent runtime" |
| AI tool definition / tool call | `packages/spec/src/contracts/ai-service.ts` `AIToolDefinition`, `ToolCallPart` | none: `name` / `toolName`, no package member |
| MCP bridge | `packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts` `bridgeTools`, `registerToolFromDefinition` | none: `server.registerTool(tool.name, …)`, `execute({ toolName: tool.name })`; the MCP SDK throws `Tool NAME is already registered` on a second name |
| agent guardrail | `packages/spec/src/ai/agent.zod.ts` `guardrails.blockedTopics` | none: exact match on the tool name |
| cloud chat (`skill.tools`) | cloud `packages/service-ai/src/skill-registry.ts#SkillRegistry.flattenToTools` | none: bare-name lookup in the tool registry (6725094995) |
| cloud MCP door, direct execute | cloud `service-ai-studio` `mcpDoorSource`, `tool-routes.ts` | none: the same bare-name `ToolRegistry` map (6725094995) |

The card's rule: if any consumer reads by bare name, `tool` joins. Every one does, on both sides, so it joins. One nuance from the cloud reading, recorded in P1.10: cloud's runtime executes from its in-process `ToolRegistry`, filled by plugins in code, and mirrors those into `tool` metadata for Studio; a package-declared `tool` item reaches no handler there. So on cloud this refusal keeps `/meta/tool/NAME` (what Studio shows) and every bare-name reference unambiguous; it does not touch the registry's own last-wins `set`, which is cloud code (see Acceptance notes).

**Responsibility** (the claim asks which change let a second same-named tool install): no change regressed it. `tool` was never covered: ADR-0048 §3.4 retired the per-item cross-package throw for every type, and phase 1's ruling list (#30803) did not name `tool`, so PR #31375 (`4a3b186c`) recorded it as "not in the list" and pinned its coexistence as a CONTROL.

**Epic #31527 / child R (#31575).** This change needs nothing from R: it adds `tool` to phase 1's refusal, which the epic's red line keeps in force until a type's own retirement child. R's package-scoped resolution would later be what lets a type leave the list.

## Verification

Two heads. The feature commits (`ff31f6f9`, `57fd18f8`, `0c19dbb4`: the last only the ADR note's text) were cut on base `69244406`; `main` then moved 13 commits, one of them under `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` (#31614), so `origin/main` was merged once at `cbd8c5b2` (no conflict). Round 2 (`30b6c84f`, on top of it) changes only the ADR text, the anchor's invariant and the changeset's declaration line; no source or test file. The delta against `origin/main` is the 8 files above. The source-level runs below are on `cbd8c5b2`, whose source and tests are byte-identical to `30b6c84f`; the gates and the three suites the seat asked for ran on `30b6c84f`:

- Unit, `packages/objectql/src/registry-bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.test.ts`: **38 passed** (was 26). With the data, request and flow families' files and `hook-binder.test.ts`: **5 files / 192 passed**, on `57fd18f8` and again on `cbd8c5b2`.
- Dogfood, the four bare-name files (booted showcase + `AppPlugin` packages + `MarketplaceInstallLocalPlugin`): **4 files / 17 passed** (`ff31f6f9`).
- Ablation on `57fd18f8` (committed first; `ablation-replace.mjs`, marker `ABL31414`: `tool` filtered out of `BARE_NAME_ONE_HOLDER_TYPES`) → unit file **10 of 38 red** (the list and `declaredBareNames` cells; for `tool`: the package door, the ABLATION cell's after-seal half, the item seam, the nested plugin, the cold-boot warn, reload/third-package and `'refuse'` cells; the reason cell). The 28 green: every agent and skill cell, the tool's same-package reload, uninstall and environment CONTROLs, the four CONTROLs. objectql rebuilt with the mutation (`ablation-dist-preflight`: marker in 4 built files; DTS failed on the mutated literal's type, TS2322, after the JS bundles were written) → dogfood AI file **2 of 5 red**: the cold-boot line did not name `the tool "qa_shared_tool"`, and `zeta` installed (`200`). Restored (blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty), rebuilt, `--absent`: marker absent from all 14 built files, tree clean.
- Consumer suites under `os-verify-lock`, every `VERDICT command-exit 0`. On `30b6c84f`: metadata-protocol **327 passed, 4 skipped / 22593 passed, 26 skipped**, rest **394 / 7546 passed, 332 skipped**, runtime (`--project local`) **562 / 9021 passed, 19 skipped**. On `cbd8c5b2` (same source and tests): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck`; objectql full suite **571 files / 11593 tests**; mcp **60 / 915**; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec tsc --noEmit`. (All five also green on the pre-merge `57fd18f8`.)
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` at `30b6c84f`: 90 derived families (the anchor file under `scripts/` adds seven to `cbd8c5b2`'s 83), each run with its exit captured before any pipe, all 90 exit 0. `--ran`: "90 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 90 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED" (exit 0). `node scripts/check-adr-anchors.mjs` exit 0. (The plugin-teardown self-test's pinned fixture was fetched first, `git fetch --depth=1 origin 621a4876…`, a shallow-clone prerequisite.)
- eslint `--no-inline-config` over `packages/objectql/src` and the dogfood file: exit 0, no findings (neither package has a `lint` script).
- Full dogfood battery (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`, under `os-verify-lock`) at `cbd8c5b2`: `VERDICT command-exit 0` · Test Files **440 passed | 3 skipped (443)** · Tests **3645 passed | 41 skipped (3686)** · no failures. Also green on `57fd18f8` (440 | 3 files, 3642 | 41 tests). Ran because the title carries `!` and the claim's line carries the `(narrowing)` arm; not re-run for `30b6c84f`, which changes no file the battery reads.

## Kept

- Same-package re-registration, the environment catalog (ADR-0005 overlay), every agent / skill / data / request / flow pin green unchanged; `rag_pipeline` keeps §3.4 as P1.9 left it; the cold boot stays `BARE_NAME_COLD_BOOT_MODE = 'warn'`.

## Acceptance notes

- Cloud's `ToolRegistry.register` is a `Map.set`: a second code-registered tool under one name silently replaces the first (cloud reading 6725094995). That is cloud code, outside this card; carrier: cloud (the cloud seat files it, per seat 1).
- Cloud mirrors code-registered tools into `tool` metadata only when absent (`register('tool', …, { notify: false })`, per the cloud reading). If that mirror ever registered package-bound after the cold-boot seal, a second plugin's same-named mirror would now be refused; the "when absent" guard means it never registers a name twice. NOT MEASURED against a running cloud build.
- The addendum's own status line still reads "one family per change (P1.2, P1.7, P1.8, P1.9 — the last)": P1.10 is a dated note after the series, not a fifth family, and the ruling named four spots, so it is left as written.
